# QR code encoder

qrcodegen.js is Project Nayuki QR Code generator v1.8.0 (MIT), compiled ES6 release. The full license is retained in the source header. Its implementation is unchanged; trailing whitespace is removed and an ESM export is appended. No runtime network or third party image service is used.
